name: MCP Server (remote, HTTP transport)
description: The same MCP server reached over HTTP instead of a local launch: runsIn 'remote', so no process is spawned and the only authority the tool holds is a mediated fetch to the declared host, counted against the budget. Placement and authority are now EXPRESSIBLE (rsj): local launch is refused on this placement, remote connection is admissible with bounds.

tools.name: mcp_remote_list_tools
tools.description: List the tools the remote MCP server exposes. Mediated: only mcp.example.com, 20 requests per session.
tools.promptSnippet: mcp_remote_list_tools lists the tools of the remote MCP server.
